findings_addressed.oracle: Independent oracle: SandboxConfig field values (network_enabled=True, memory_limit_mb=8192, clipboard_enabled=True, etc.) and WindowsSandbox.SANDBOX_SHARED_PATH constant are used to compute all expected XML text independently; nothing is read back from the written file into the expected-value expressions. The real production method WindowsSandbox._generate_wsb_config() is driven end-to-end (via getattr to satisfy reportPrivateUsage) and the written WSB file is parsed by defusedxml to assert exact tag text matches.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/sandbox/windows.py line 1162, change 'networking = "Enable" if self._config.network_enabled else "Disable"' to 'networking = "Disable"' — the test would fail because the config has network_enabled=True so the assertion 'root.findtext("Networking") == "Enable"' would receive "Disable".

findings_addressed.oracle: Independent oracle: SandboxConfig field values and WindowsSandbox.SANDBOX_SHARED_PATH are used to compute expected text values; the roundtrip assertion parses the file bytes back through defusedxml and checks exact node text. The real production method _generate_wsb_config() writes the file and the assertion is against independently computed oracle strings, not the file content itself.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/sandbox/windows.py line 1165, change 'SubElement(config, "MemoryInMB").text = str(self._config.memory_limit_mb)' to 'SubElement(config, "MemoryInMB").text = "0"' — the test would fail because the assertion expects '8192' (from cfg.memory_limit_mb=8192) but would find '0'.

notes: Both G0115 and G0116 were tautological: the original tests called a test-internal helper _build_wsb_config_tree() and asserted on data the test itself constructed, never touching the real production method WindowsSandbox._generate_wsb_config(). The hardened tests drive the real async method end-to-end by injecting _wsb_path and _shared_folder via setattr (using string-literal attribute names to satisfy reportPrivateUsage) and using getattr to invoke _generate_wsb_config. Oracle values are computed independently from SandboxConfig inputs and WindowsSandbox.SANDBOX_SHARED_PATH — never from the written file. Both hardened tests are guarded with skipif(sys.platform != 'win32') because WindowsSandbox is a Windows-only production class that imports win32-specific modules. The original three non-flagged tests (test_indent_produces_human_readable_layout, test_special_characters_in_text_are_escaped, test_tostring_bytes_default_encoding) are unchanged.
